fullName.description: The name shown on the profile.

bearerAuth.description: A signed JWT from POST /api/auth/login, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. "Bearer" is meant literally: whoever holds it is the account, so it is only safe over TLS or, as here, on localhost. It expires after 15 minutes and cannot be revoked before then.

info.description:
Accounts: register, log in for a token, and read or change your profile. Start here - the token from POST /api/auth/login unlocks every other document.

**Conventions**

- Every endpoint lives under `/api` and is reached through the gateway. A service's own port is not for clients.
- Money is a decimal with two places; totals are always calculated on the server and never taken from the request.
- Endpoints marked with a padlock need a token. Call `POST /api/auth/login` (the **customer** document), copy the `accessToken`, and paste it into **Authorize** above - then "Try it out" sends it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- Every failure returns the same shape, `{"status": <code>, "message": <text>}` - see the `ApiError` schema.
info.title: EcomDemo Customer API

post.description:
Verifies the password with BCrypt — the only time per session that cost is paid — and returns a signed JWT carrying the account's id and roles.

The token is short-lived and cannot be revoked before it expires, so treat it like a password: whoever holds it is the account, which is what "Bearer" means.

200.description: The token, its type and when it expires

401.description: The credentials are wrong. The message deliberately does not say whether it was the username or the password.

429.description: Too many failed logins for this username or from this address. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header, then try again.

post.summary: Log in and receive a token

get.description: Reads the account behind the credentials on the request. There is no "get user by id" endpoint: an account is only ever visible to itself.

401.description: No Bearer token, or one that is invalid or expired

put.description: The only editable field. The username identifies the account everywhere else in the schema, and the role is a privilege rather than a preference.

400.description: fullName is blank or longer than 100 characters

401.description: No Bearer token, or one that is invalid or expired

post.description:
The one endpoint besides browsing the catalogue that an anonymous caller may use — requiring an account in order to create an account would be a closed loop.

The password is hashed with BCrypt on arrival and is never stored, logged or returned. The new account is always a CUSTOMER: the role cannot be chosen by the caller.

201.description: The account was created. The Location header points at the profile.

400.description: A field is missing, the username has illegal characters, or the password is shorter than 8 characters

servers.description: The gateway this document was fetched through

tags.description: Log in once, then send the returned token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other call. This is the only endpoint that accepts a password.
